class Point {
  x;
  y;
  constructor(input: {x: number; y: number}) {
    ({x: this.x, y: this.y} = input);
  }
}
class Nested {
  value;
  tail;
  rest;
  constructor(input: {nested: {value?: number}; extra: string}, values: [number, ...string[]]) {
    ({nested: {value: this.value = 9}, ...this.rest} = input);
    [, ...this.tail] = values;
  }
}
class Ordered {
  value;
  constructor(values: [string, string]) {
    [this.value, this.value] = values;
  }
}
class Branch {
  value;
  constructor(flag: boolean, input: {x: number}, values: [number]) {
    if (flag) ({x: this.value} = input);
    else [this.value] = values;
  }
}
const point = new Point({x: 3, y: 4});
const nested = new Nested({nested: {}, extra: 'kept'}, [1, 'a', 'b']);
const numberValue: number = point.x;
const defaultValue: number = nested.value;
const tailValue: (string | number)[] = nested.tail;
const restValue: {extra: string} = nested.rest;
const ordered: number | string = new Ordered(['first', 'last']).value;
console.log(numberValue, point.y, defaultValue, tailValue, restValue, ordered, new Branch(false, {x: 2}, [3]).value);
nested.rest = true;
console.log(nested.rest);
class Computed {
  key;
  value;
  constructor(input: {x: number}) { ({[(this.key = 'x')]: this.value} = input); }
}
class Defaults {
  other;
  value;
  constructor(input: {value?: number}) { ({value: this.value = (this.other = 9)} = input); }
}
const key: string = new Computed({x: 2}).key;
const value: number = new Computed({x: 2}).value;
const other: number | undefined = new Defaults({value: 2}).other;
console.log(key, value, new Defaults({}).other, other);
